# AccessRequest

## Properties

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**ApprovalUrl** | Pointer to **string** | Authenticated platform URL generated by the backend; not an authorization capability. Pending requests have no review TTL. | [optional] 
**ApprovedAt** | Pointer to **time.Time** | Original approval-operation timestamp, set on the first transition to APPROVING; retries, reconnect, and recovery never reset it. | [optional] 
**ApprovedBy** | Pointer to **string** | Approver user ID for manual approval or the reserved auto-approved actor for automatic approval. Set when approval enters APPROVING and retained thereafter. | [optional] 
**CreatedAt** | Pointer to **time.Time** | Server time when the request was created. | [optional] 
**DeploymentCellId** | Pointer to **string** | ID of a Host Cluster | [optional] 
**EnvironmentType** | Pointer to **string** | The type of service environment | [optional] 
**ExpiresAt** | Pointer to **time.Time** | Original approvedAt-derived expiry. Required for approved grants, including automatic approval. Omitted before approval and not editable or renewable. | [optional] 
**Id** | Pointer to **string** | Server-generated ID of a provider cluster access request. | [optional] 
**Reason** | Pointer to **string** | The access reason supplied for manual approval. The backend requires a nonblank reason for MANUAL; automatic approval may use a backend-generated reason or omit it. | [optional] 
**RequesterUserId** | Pointer to **string** | ID of a User | [optional] 
**RevokedAt** | Pointer to **time.Time** | Server time of terminal revocation. | [optional] 
**RevokedBy** | Pointer to **string** | ID of a User | [optional] 
**Role** | Pointer to **string** | Requested Kubernetes access role. Known values: cluster-reader, cluster-admin. The server validates authorization; role is not part of requester-plus-cell deduplication. Clients must preserve unknown future values. | [optional] 
**ServiceProviderOrgId** | Pointer to **string** | ID of an Org | [optional] 
**Status** | Pointer to **string** | Access request lifecycle status. Known values: PENDING, APPROVING, APPROVED, REVOKING, DENIED, REVOKED, EXPIRED. APPROVED covers both manual and automatic approval. Clients must preserve unknown future values. | [optional]
